latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of free-avatar-video — generate avatar videos from text.

- Generate talking avatar videos in the cloud from text/script (TXT, DOCX, PDF, MP4, up to 200MB).
- No camera needed: just upload or describe what you want, receive 1080p MP4 output in 1–2 minutes.
- Designed for marketers, educators, and creators working with text or scripts.
- Automatic API setup with free anonymous token flow; credits system with 7-day expiry.
- Supports quick edits, batch uploads, and iterative workflows.
- Common file formats accepted; guidance on errors and platform compatibility included.
